method: Inductive profiler (JD's skill): conclusions cite their observations, are graded Tentative (1-2 supporting observations) / Probable (3+, none contradicting) / Strong (6+, none contradicting), carry a falsifier, and are scoped to this dataset. Fields of study are taken only where a profile's own data states them (Degrees column, or an explicit degree phrase in the synopsis/footprint); a job alone never counts as a degree. Persona = JD's six rated rows (Big Five + Ego, 1-5); blanks stay blank. Direction uses a +/-0.3 deadband around the directory mean per trait. Lab only — nothing here is filed to any profile.
